executive_summary: Cameron Young commands the top of the board at the Rocket Classic with the field's best SG Total (+1.93) and SG Approach (+0.78), giving him an 8.1% model win probability — nearly double the next closest competitor. J.J. Spaun profiles as one of the most compelling names in the mid-tier: he ranks second in the field in SG Approach (+0.76), owns the best course history adjustment at Detroit Golf Club (+0.133 strokes), and posted a T10 here in 2024. Among longshots, Nicolai Hojgaard stands out with a positive course history adjustment (+0.026) across three straight starts at Detroit Golf Club and a 15.6% top-10 probability, making him a legitimate contender in a wide-open event where 143 players are vying for the title.

insights.title: Cameron Young Is the Clear Model Alpha
insights.insight: Young leads the field in SG Total (+1.93), SG Approach (+0.78), and model win probability (8.1%). His T6 at Detroit Golf Club in 2024 adds historical substance to an elite statistical profile, and his ball-striking dominance is tailor-made for a course that rewards precision iron play.

insights.title: J.J. Spaun's Detroit Golf Club Pedigree Shines
insights.insight: Spaun boasts the field's highest course history adjustment (+0.133 strokes) at Detroit Golf Club, backed by finishes of T10 (2024) and T33 (2023). He also ranks second in SG Approach (+0.76) and has the best course fit score (-0.042) among the top 10 favorites, giving him a 22.2% model top-10 probability.

insights.title: Schauffele Brings Elite Talent, No Course Data
insights.insight: Xander Schauffele ranks second in SG Total (+1.68) and fifth in SG Approach (+0.63), projecting for a 4.7% win probability. With no prior starts at Detroit Golf Club, there's no course history to lean on, but his pure skill ceiling in this field is surpassed only by Young.

insights.title: Ben Griffin: Dual-Threat Ball-Striker and Putter
insights.insight: Griffin is one of only two players to rank in the top 7 in both SG Total (+1.39) and SG Putting (+0.45, 5th in the field). His three consecutive starts at Detroit Golf Club (T33, T31, T13) show a clear upward trend, and the model projects him for a 21.5% top-10 probability.

insights.title: Wyndham Clark's Putter Could Unlock Upside
insights.insight: Clark ranks second in the entire field in SG Putting (+0.54) while carrying a strong +1.39 SG Total, yielding a 21.9% model top-10 probability. His missed cut in 2025 at Detroit Golf Club is a flag, but his positive course history adjustment (+0.038) suggests the MC may have been an outlier rather than a pattern.

insights.title: Nicolai Hojgaard Tops Course Fit Leaderboard
insights.insight: Hojgaard owns the best course fit score in the field at -0.027 and carries a solid +1.00 SG Total with a 15.6% top-10 probability. His positive course history adjustment (+0.026) complements the fit profile, making him the model's strongest longshot projection.

insights.title: Rickie Fowler: 2023 Champion Returns at Range
insights.insight: Fowler, the 2023 Rocket Classic champion, projects for a 13.2% top-10 probability at +7190. His SG Total of +0.80 is modest relative to the top tier, but his proven ability to win at Detroit Golf Club provides a history-based floor that pure stats may not fully capture.

insights.title: Si Woo Kim's Iron Play Belies Poor History
insights.insight: Kim ranks third in SG Approach (+0.74) and third in SG Total (+1.66), driving a 4.0% win probability. However, his Detroit Golf Club results are alarming — 84th in 2025, MC in 2024, and T74 in 2023 — and his course fit (-0.073) is one of the weakest among favorites. The talent is undeniable, but the venue has not rewarded it.

insights.title: Cantlay's Iron Play Anchors Top-10 Projection
insights.insight: Patrick Cantlay ranks fourth in SG Approach (+0.67) and carries a 23.1% model top-10 probability — the highest among all model standouts. His T32 in 2025 at Detroit Golf Club was unremarkable, but a positive course history adjustment (+0.021) and elite ball-striking suggest a higher ceiling this week.

insights.title: Akshay Bhatia: Putter-Driven Sleeper at +6222
insights.insight: Bhatia ranks third in the field in SG Putting (+0.50) and carries a +0.99 SG Total, projecting for a 14.3% top-10 probability. On a Donald Ross design like Detroit Golf Club where scrambling and touch around the greens can separate players, his flat-stick prowess makes him a compelling longshot play.
